title: Special Executive Master Programme in Healthcare Administration
description: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Healthcare Administration is a comprehensive course designed for healthcare professionals seeking advanced healthcare management, policy, and leadership skills to enhance their career prospects in the healthcare industry.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Healthcare Administration is designed to equip healthcare professionals with the skills and knowledge necessary to excel in leadership and management roles within the healthcare industry. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Healthcare Administration allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications. This programme aims to deliver a practical and realistic solution to a strategic Healthcare Administration challenge, supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The objective of the Special Executive Master Programme in Healthcare Administration qualification is to prepare students for leadership roles in healthcare organisations by providing them with knowledge and skills in healthcare management, policy, finance, and operations. This qualification reflects current practices in Healthcare Administration and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of health and health issues. Course Details: Healthcare Policies: This module explores the regulatory frameworks and policies governing healthcare systems Managing Healthcare Organisations: In this module, learners gain insights into managing various healthcare organisations, such as hospitals, clinics, and long-term care facilities. Leadership and Organisational Behaviour: This module focuses on developing leadership skills and understanding organisational behaviour in healthcare settings. Strategic Management: This module introduces learners to strategic planning and execution within healthcare organisations. Human Resource Management: This module covers human resource practices in healthcare, including recruitment, training, performance management, and employee relations. Operations Management: In this module, learners study the principles of operations management, focusing on the efficient delivery of healthcare services. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Healthcare Administration and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The management of human beings in a complex organisation- including human resource planning and development, assessment of future needs, building the personnel function to meet the needs of developing organisations, and developing career paths, training programs, and policies. Resource loyalties, managing personnel to elevate individual contribution and increase quality, and lowering operational costs topics are additionally covered in this course.

modules.title: OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The production and operation functions in a business are the themes of this course. Evaluation and growth of production and operations management (POM); POM problems; productivity (planning and control) and its measurement; forecasting demand; basic qualitative and quantitative forecasting techniques in major production; inventory control; single and multiple period inventories; statistical quality control; management problems; and case studies.
